target.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to video catalog requests
target.body:
## Summary
- OpenRouter video catalog discovery and per-model capability resolution now pass configured provider request overrides into `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig` instead of silently ignoring `models.providers.openrouter.request`.
- The catalog fetch now uses the resolved request headers and private-network policy while preserving OpenRouter's API-key authorization and attribution headers.
- collision check: searched `openrouter video catalog request policy`, `sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest openrouter catalog`, and `openrouter video-model-catalog allowPrivateNetwork`; no same-problem PR was found. OpenRouter image/music request-policy siblings were intentionally left out because open PRs currently touch those same files.

## Verification
- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/video-generation-provider.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  18 passed (18)`.
- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/openrouter/video-model-catalog.ts extensions/openrouter/video-generation-provider.test.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check` - passed; exit 0.
- mutation check: temporarily removing the two catalog `request:` parameters made the focused Vitest fail with `expected undefined to deeply equal { allowPrivateNetwork: true, headers: ... }` for both live catalog discovery and per-model capability resolution; restoring the patch returned the test to green.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: OpenRouter video catalog HTTP requests now honor configured provider request overrides such as custom headers and `allowPrivateNetwork`.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; focused Vitest drives the real exported `listOpenRouterVideoModelCatalog` and `resolveModelCapabilities` paths with a configured OpenRouter provider request policy and the real catalog fetch helper boundary mocked only at the outbound HTTP guard.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openrouter/video-generation-provider.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the focused tests assert `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig` receives the configured request overrides, the final catalog GET includes the configured header, and the guarded fetch receives `{ allowPrivateNetwork: true }` for both catalog listing and per-model capability resolution.

Observed result after fix: `Test Files  1 passed (1)` and `Tests  18 passed (18)`.

What was not tested: no live OpenRouter endpoint was called; the proof validates OpenClaw's request-policy plumbing locally without sending third-party network traffic.
